config.name: LCBench wide 15 min (16 slots, runs x0.1), Busy Machines with Opus + planner cadence 90 s seed 0 [dry run]

checks: planner cadence (calls the AI planner at most every N seconds; the no-AI sampler keeps GPUs busy in between) on opus_bm: at most one propose call per 90 s (between call starts); K = min(max_proposals_per_call, LLM demand); judge calls not throttled
optuna median rule matches the BM arms (False)
backfill (no-AI sampler fills free slots, LLM proposals first) on ['opus_bm']
lean planner (propose v2, effort low; shorter planner replies: only the settings it changes) on ['opus_bm']

backfill.label: keeps GPUs busy with a no-AI sampler while the AI thinks

table.source: deterministic surrogate: same config, same result for every seed

planner_cadence.k_rule: K = min(max_proposals_per_call, LLM demand) when the call is due; LLM demand counts only the LLM's own runs and buffered proposals (backfill)
planner_cadence.label: calls the AI planner at most every 90 s; the no-AI sampler keeps GPUs busy in between
planner_cadence.measured: between the starts of propose calls

mubit_projects.note: D38: project B holds the closed-output judge v1 / early_stop tasks; A everything else

checks: LLM arms share researcher, retry/fallback policy and every non-planner prompt
planner per arm as declared: opus=v1/medium, opus_bm=v2/low (declared difference only on ['opus_bm'])

opus_bm.label: shorter planner replies: only the settings it changes
